card.name: Drug is only minimally absorbed or excreted
card.fires_on: The word 'only' or 'not' (or the end of 'minimally' or 'negligibly') right after 'drug X is' or 'does', when the sentence says the drug is barely absorbed, excreted, bound or effective.

modes.label: Limiting word after is
modes.description: 'only' or 'not' right after a drug name and 'is', before absorbed, excreted or effective.
modes.example: Sucralfate is<< only>> minimally absorbed from the gastrointestinal tract.

modes.label: Negation after does
modes.description: 'not' after a drug name and 'does', before a verb like eliminate or treat.
modes.example: Chloroquine does<< not>> treat the hypnozoite liver stage

modes.label: Inside the qualifier
modes.description: The end of a hedge such as minimally or negligibly in the same kind of sentence.
modes.example: Metformin is neglig<<ibly>> bound to plasma proteins and is, therefore
